diagnostics.name: InvalidScopeDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A scoped line is not scoped to <scope>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateScope
diagnostics.title: A query declares more than one scope, and results are narrowed one way.

diagnostics.name: InvalidUiProfileDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A ui profile line is not ui profile <Name>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateUiProfile
diagnostics.title: Two ui profile blocks in the same document declare the same name.

diagnostics.name: InvalidTargetDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A target line under a ui profile is neither target platform ... nor target size ....

diagnostics.name: DuplicateTargetDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A ui profile declares target platform or target size more than once.

diagnostics.name: InvalidPackageName
diagnostics.title: A line under a packages block is not a valid package name.

diagnostics.name: DuplicatePackageDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A ui profile's packages block lists the same package more than once.

diagnostics.name: UnknownUiProfileDirective
diagnostics.title: A line in a ui profile body is not target or packages, or packages is declared more than once.

diagnostics.name: InvalidFormDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A form line is not form <Name> for <Command>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateForm
diagnostics.title: Two form blocks in the same document declare the same name.

diagnostics.name: UnknownFormDirective
diagnostics.title: A line in a form body is not populate, field or on submit.

diagnostics.name: InvalidPopulateDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A populate line is neither populate via query ... nor populate from item.

diagnostics.name: DuplicatePopulate
diagnostics.title: A form declares populate more than once.

diagnostics.name: InvalidFormField
diagnostics.title: A field line is not field <property> [from <source>|compose using <Callback>] [label "..."].

diagnostics.name: InvalidFormSubmit
diagnostics.title: An on submit line is not on submit navigate to <Screen> [by <param>].

diagnostics.name: DuplicateFormSubmit
diagnostics.title: A form declares on submit more than once.

diagnostics.name: UnknownFormFieldProperty
diagnostics.title: A field binds to a property its form's command does not declare.

diagnostics.name: InvalidContributionDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A contribute line is not contribute to <ContributionPoint>.

diagnostics.name: UnknownContributionDirective
diagnostics.title: A line in a contribute to body is not navigate, label or order.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateContributionNavigate
diagnostics.title: A contribution declares navigate to more than once.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateContributionLabel
diagnostics.title: A contribution declares label more than once.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateContributionOrder
diagnostics.title: A contribution declares order more than once.

diagnostics.name: InvalidContributionLabel
diagnostics.title: A contribution's label line is not label "..." or label $strings.....

diagnostics.name: InvalidOrderDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A contribution's order line is not order <number>.

diagnostics.name: UnknownContributionPoint
diagnostics.title: A contribution names a contribution point nothing in scope declares.

diagnostics.name: InvalidThemeDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A theme line is not theme <Name>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateTheme
diagnostics.title: Two theme blocks in the same document declare the same name.

diagnostics.name: InvalidCompatibleWithDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A line in a theme body is not compatible with <Package>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateCompatibleWith
diagnostics.title: A theme declares compatibility with the same package more than once.

diagnostics.name: InvalidProfileTheme
diagnostics.title: A ui profile's theme line is not theme <Name>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateProfileTheme
diagnostics.title: A ui profile declares theme more than once.

diagnostics.name: UnknownTheme
diagnostics.title: A ui profile selects a theme nothing in the document declares.

diagnostics.name: ThemeNotCompatibleWithPackage
diagnostics.title: A ui profile selects a theme not declared compatible with one of the profile's own packages.

diagnostics.name: InvalidArrangementDeclaration
diagnostics.title: An arrangement line is not arrangement flow or arrangement freeform.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateArrangement
diagnostics.title: A layout, screen template or dialog template declares arrangement more than once.

diagnostics.name: InvalidArrangementContainer
diagnostics.title: A row, column or grid line in an arrangement is malformed.

diagnostics.name: InvalidArrangementSlotAttributes
diagnostics.title: A slot leaf within an arrangement tree has malformed sizing attributes.

diagnostics.name: InvalidArrangementOverride
diagnostics.title: A when override line in an arrangement is not a valid width/height size-class condition.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateArrangementOverride
diagnostics.title: An arrangement declares more than one when override for the same width/height size-class combination.

diagnostics.name: ArrangementDirectiveMismatch
diagnostics.title: An arrangement block's body does not match its mode - a flow arrangement declares a variant, or a freeform arrangement declares anything other than one.

diagnostics.name: InvalidVariantDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A variant line is not variant width <compact|regular>, height <compact|regular>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateVariant
diagnostics.title: An arrangement declares more than one variant for the same width/height size-class combination.

diagnostics.name: InvalidPlaceDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A place line is not place <Slot> hidden or place <Slot> at x,y size w,h.

diagnostics.name: DuplicatePlaceInVariant
diagnostics.title: A variant places (or hides) the same slot more than once.

diagnostics.name: VariantMissingSlot
diagnostics.title: A freeform arrangement's variant does not mention (place or hide) a slot another variant of the same arrangement places.

diagnostics.name: InvalidTriggerDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A trigger line is not trigger <Name>.

diagnostics.name: InvalidTriggerData
diagnostics.title: A line in a trigger body is neither a description nor a value the trigger provides.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateTrigger
diagnostics.title: The document declares two triggers by the same name, leaving no answer to which one a reaction means.

diagnostics.name: UnknownTrigger
diagnostics.title: A when line names neither an event nor a trigger the document or the compiler knows.

diagnostics.name: InvalidIntervalTrigger
diagnostics.title: An every line is not every <n> <seconds|minutes|hours|days>.

diagnostics.name: InvalidScheduleTrigger
diagnostics.title: An at line is not at <HH:mm>, optionally followed by on <Weekday> or on day <n>.

diagnostics.name: UnknownTriggerData
diagnostics.title: A reaction takes a value from an occurrence that the trigger does not provide.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateReactionCondition
diagnostics.title: A reaction states more than one where, and a reaction is narrowed by one condition.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateReactionTrigger
diagnostics.title: A reaction declares the same trigger more than once, so the second says nothing the first did not.

diagnostics.name: InvalidScreenTemplateDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A screen template line is not screen template <Name>.

diagnostics.name: InvalidDialogTemplateDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A dialog template line is not dialog template <Name>.

diagnostics.name: InvalidFitsSlotDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A fits slot line is not fits slot <name>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateFitsSlot
diagnostics.title: A screen template declares fits slot more than once.

diagnostics.name: FitsSlotNotAllowed
diagnostics.title: A layout or a dialog template declares fits slot - neither fills a slot of a parent structure.

diagnostics.name: InvalidLayoutDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A top level layout line is not layout <Name>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateLayout
diagnostics.title: A document declares more than one layout by the same name.

diagnostics.name: InvalidProfileLayout
diagnostics.title: A ui profile's layout line is not layout <Name>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateProfileLayout
diagnostics.title: A ui profile declares layout more than once.

diagnostics.name: UnknownLayout
diagnostics.title: A ui profile selects a layout nothing in the document declares.

diagnostics.name: AbsoluteFileReference
diagnostics.title: A file directive names an absolute path, and a file reference is relative to the repository root.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationQuery
diagnostics.title: A then query line does not name a query.

diagnostics.name: UnknownSpecificationQueryDirective
diagnostics.title: A line in a then query body is neither arguments nor result.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateSpecificationQueryArguments
diagnostics.title: A then query assertion declares its arguments block more than once.

diagnostics.name: UnsupportedSemanticSyntax
diagnostics.title: Source syntax carries portable behavior that ESM v1 cannot represent.

diagnostics.name: DeferredSemanticSyntax
diagnostics.title: Source syntax is explicitly deferred from the current backend semantic profile.

diagnostics.name: ReportOnlySemanticSyntax
diagnostics.title: Source syntax is realization or operational metadata rather than portable behavior.

diagnostics.name: PreservedLegacySemanticSyntax
diagnostics.title: Source syntax keeps its legacy meaning but cannot be strengthened into ESM v1 implicitly.

diagnostics.name: SemanticMigrationRequired
diagnostics.title: Source syntax requires an explicit reviewed semantic migration before binding.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSemanticBinding
diagnostics.title: The source syntax and identity catalog could not produce a coherent semantic compilation.

diagnostics.name: UnknownSemanticSourceDocument
diagnostics.title: A syntax location cannot be mapped to one of the supplied semantic source documents.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationEventSource
diagnostics.title: A specification event-source assertion is missing or malformed.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateSpecificationEventSource
diagnostics.title: A specification step declares its event-source assertion more than once.

diagnostics.name: InvalidProjectionVariantDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A variant line is not variant <Name>.

diagnostics.name: ProjectionVariantWithoutEntersOn
diagnostics.title: A variant declares no enters on event, so nothing ever activates it.

diagnostics.name: InvalidEntersOnDeclaration
diagnostics.title: An enters on line is not enters on <EventType> [key <expression>].

diagnostics.name: NestedProjectionVariantNotAllowed
diagnostics.title: A variant is declared inside another variant, and variants do not nest.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateProjectionVariantName
diagnostics.title: Two variants of the same projection declare the same name.

diagnostics.name: UnknownValidationTarget
diagnostics.title: A declarative validation rule targets no declared command field.

diagnostics.name: IncompatibleReadsKey
diagnostics.title: A read key's type is incompatible with every declared query parameter of its view.

diagnostics.name: UnpopulatedProjectionField
diagnostics.title: No mapping in a child or nested projection populates a declared element field.

diagnostics.name: UnreachableSpecificationOutcome
diagnostics.title: A specification outcome contradicts every applicable declared producer mapping.

diagnostics.name: UnknownSpecificationEnumMember
diagnostics.title: A specification supplies a value outside its field's declared enumeration.

diagnostics.name: UnknownEventField
diagnostics.title: A producer or specification assigns a field the referenced event does not declare.

diagnostics.name: AuthoringSourceNormalization
diagnostics.title: A typed authoring change canonicalizes a document and may discard source comments or trivia.

diagnostics.name: EmptyAuthoringWorkspace
diagnostics.title: An empty authoring workspace has no source documents and is not executable.

diagnostics.name: RedundantImport
diagnostics.title: An import names something the application declares itself, so it has no effect.

diagnostics.name: InvalidStructuredValue
diagnostics.title: An inline JSON-shaped value is malformed.

diagnostics.name: UnknownStructuredValueMember
diagnostics.title: A structured value names no property in its declared composite target.

diagnostics.name: IncompatibleStructuredValue
diagnostics.title: A structured value has the wrong shape for its declared target.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateStructuredValueMember
diagnostics.title: An inline object declares the same property name more than once.

diagnostics.name: UnknownEventContextMember
diagnostics.title: An $eventContext.<path> opens with a member the event context does not have.

diagnostics.name: UnknownEventContextPath
diagnostics.title: An $eventContext.<path> continues into something the member before it does not have.

diagnostics.name: EventContextPathBelowCollection
diagnostics.title: An $eventContext.<path> continues below a collection - causation or tags - which has no addressing grammar and never resolves.

diagnostics.name: MissingEventContextPath
diagnostics.title: An $eventContext reference names no member, or has an empty segment.

diagnostics.name: UnresolvedDynamicKeySource
diagnostics.title: A dynamic dictionary key names a $ source other than $eventContext, which the runtime never resolves.

diagnostics.name: InvalidBehaviorDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A behavior declaration is not of the form behavior <Name>.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateBehavior
diagnostics.title: A behavior name is declared more than once.

diagnostics.name: UnknownBehaviorDirective
diagnostics.title: A line in a behavior body is not one of description, parameter, order or an on binding.

diagnostics.name: InvalidBehaviorParameter
diagnostics.title: A behavior parameter declaration is not of the form parameter <name> [<Type>].

diagnostics.name: DuplicateBehaviorParameter
diagnostics.title: A behavior declares the same parameter name more than once.

diagnostics.name: InvalidBehaviorOrder
diagnostics.title: A behavior order is not an integer.

diagnostics.name: BehaviorWithoutBindings
diagnostics.title: A behavior declares no bindings, so nothing can ever run.

diagnostics.name: InvalidInteractionTrigger
diagnostics.title: An on clause does not name a built-in interaction kind, an event, an interval or a declared application trigger.

diagnostics.name: InteractionBindingWithoutActions
diagnostics.title: An interaction binding declares no actions, so its trigger has nothing to do.

diagnostics.name: RepeatedInteractionCondition
diagnostics.title: An interaction binding declares where more than once.

diagnostics.name: UnknownInteractionAction
diagnostics.title: A line where an action was expected does not name one of the action kinds.

diagnostics.name: InvalidExecuteAction
diagnostics.title: An execute action is not of the form execute <Command>.

diagnostics.name: InvalidNavigateAction
diagnostics.title: A navigate action is neither navigate to <Screen> nor navigate back.

diagnostics.name: InvalidOpenDialogAction
diagnostics.title: An open dialog action does not name a dialog template.

diagnostics.name: InvalidRefreshAction
diagnostics.title: A refresh action does not name a query.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSetAction
diagnostics.title: A set action is not of the form set <target> to <value>.

diagnostics.name: InvalidNotifyAction
diagnostics.title: A notify action is not of the form notify <info|warning|error> "<text>".

diagnostics.name: InvalidConfirmAction
diagnostics.title: A confirm action does not carry a message.

diagnostics.name: InvalidRaiseAction
diagnostics.title: A raise action does not name an application trigger.

diagnostics.name: InvalidInteractionArgument
diagnostics.title: An action argument is not of the form with <name> from <binding>.

diagnostics.name: ContinuationOnNonFailableAction
diagnostics.title: A continuation is attached to an action that cannot fail, so it could never run.

diagnostics.name: ResultContinuationOnNonDialogAction
diagnostics.title: An on result continuation is attached to something other than open dialog.

diagnostics.name: InvalidUsesDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A uses clause is not of the form uses <Behavior>.

diagnostics.name: InvalidBehaviorArgument
diagnostics.title: An argument at a uses site is not of the form <parameter> <value>.

diagnostics.name: InteractionNestingTooDeep
diagnostics.title: Interaction nesting went deeper than the compiler admits.

diagnostics.name: IntervalBelowFloor
diagnostics.title: An interval trigger is below the floor a client can honour.

diagnostics.name: ApplicationTriggerCollidesWithInteractionKind
diagnostics.title: An application trigger is declared with a name reserved as a built-in interaction kind.

diagnostics.name: UnknownActionCommand
diagnostics.title: An action names a command the document does not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnknownActionScreen
diagnostics.title: A navigate to action names a screen the document does not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnknownActionQuery
diagnostics.title: A refresh action names a query the document does not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnknownActionDialogTemplate
diagnostics.title: An open dialog action names a dialog template the document does not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnknownActionTrigger
diagnostics.title: A raise action or an on clause names an application trigger the document does not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnknownInteractionEvent
diagnostics.title: An on event clause names an event the document does not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnknownUsedBehavior
diagnostics.title: A uses clause names a behavior the document does not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnknownBehaviorArgument
diagnostics.title: A uses site supplies an argument the behavior does not declare a parameter for.

diagnostics.name: MissingBehaviorArgument
diagnostics.title: A uses site leaves a behavior parameter without an argument.

diagnostics.name: UnreachableInteractionContinuation
diagnostics.title: Actions follow an unconditional navigation, so they could never run.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateBehaviorAttachment
diagnostics.title: Another file of a folder repeats an attachment of a module or feature - the same behavior with the same arguments, or an identical inline behavior - so the repeat is ignored.

diagnostics.name: InvalidActionAlternative
diagnostics.title: A guarded action child is not an alternative, fallback or navigation.

diagnostics.name: GuardedActionWithoutAlternatives
diagnostics.title: A guarded action declares no condition alternatives.

diagnostics.name: MisplacedActionOtherwise
diagnostics.title: A guarded action repeats its fallback or declares an alternative after it.

diagnostics.name: UnsupportedActionConditionOperand
diagnostics.title: A guarded action condition uses an unsupported operand or operator value type.

diagnostics.name: UnknownActionSubjectField
diagnostics.title: An item path names no subject field or crosses a collection field.

diagnostics.name: UnresolvedActionSubject
diagnostics.title: A guarded action has no unambiguous data subject in its enclosing containers.

diagnostics.name: UnreachableActionAlternative
diagnostics.title: Earlier guarded alternatives provably shadow an alternative.

diagnostics.name: UnknownActionArgumentProperty
diagnostics.title: An explicit action argument names no property of the chosen command or has mismatched collection cardinality.

diagnostics.name: NullSpecificationFact
diagnostics.title: A command or event specification value uses null instead of modeling an optional fact as a separate event.

diagnostics.name: MissingSpecificationReadModelIdentifier
diagnostics.title: A read model state does not state its identifier property.

diagnostics.name: InvalidWhenlessSpecification
diagnostics.title: A specification without a command has an incompatible or missing outcome.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationNull
diagnostics.title: A specification value is null where its declared type or role disallows null.

diagnostics.name: MissingStructuredValueMember
diagnostics.title: A specification composite value omits a required declared property.

diagnostics.name: UnresolvedStructuredValueType
diagnostics.title: The declared composite target of a specification value could not be resolved.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateSemanticValueMember
diagnostics.title: A specification composite value declares the same member more than once in typed syntax.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSemanticStringKey
diagnostics.title: A localized semantic message does not name a valid dotted string key.

diagnostics.name: ConflictingSpecificationActions
diagnostics.title: A specification declares more than one action.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationEventOrder
diagnostics.title: An event-order comparison qualifier is malformed or repeated.

diagnostics.name: UnknownMatchPattern
diagnostics.title: A named match pattern has no portable definition.

diagnostics.name: InvalidMatchPattern
diagnostics.title: A quoted match pattern is not a valid ECMAScript regular expression.

diagnostics.name: InvalidValidationSeverity
diagnostics.title: A validation rule names a severity other than information, warning or error.

diagnostics.name: InvalidRequirementSeverity
diagnostics.title: A command requirement has an invalid or repeated severity directive.

diagnostics.name: PartiallyLoweredProjectionSyntax
diagnostics.title: A projection construct binds, but Chronicle's projection lowering drops part of it: all inside a children or nested block loses its subscription to every event type, and an auto-map setting on a joined event is replaced by the level's.

diagnostics.name: UnusedProjectionKey
diagnostics.title: A projection-level key is accepted by the parser but is not used to route events by Chronicle.

diagnostics.name: VariantRequiresEnteringEvent
diagnostics.title: A projection variant has no entering event.

diagnostics.name: GlobalHandlerPropertyNotOnVariant
diagnostics.title: A shared projection handler maps a member absent from a known variant shape.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateProjectionVariant
diagnostics.title: Two variants of the same projection use the same name.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateVariantEnteringEvent
diagnostics.title: An entering event activates more than one variant of the same projection.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationCaller
diagnostics.title: A given caller fixture line is malformed.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateSpecificationCallerOrDenied
diagnostics.title: A specification declares more than one caller or denied outcome.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationDenied
diagnostics.title: A denied outcome has an invalid shape or conflicts with another outcome.

diagnostics.name: MissingSpecificationCaller
diagnostics.title: An authorized specification has no explicitly supplied caller fixture.

diagnostics.name: UnknownConstraintEvent
diagnostics.title: A unique constraint names an event the application does not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnknownConstraintProperty
diagnostics.title: A unique <property> on <Event> constraint names a property the event does not declare.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateConstraintName
diagnostics.title: Two constraints share a name. The name is a constraint's identity in the event store, so it is unique across the whole application.

diagnostics.name: InvalidConstraintCasing
diagnostics.title: Ignoring casing is only meaningful for unique property values, not unique event occurrences.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateAuthorizationAcrossFiles
diagnostics.title: Another file repeats an identical authorization gate on the same module or feature.

diagnostics.name: FileConstraintOnlySupportsUniqueness
diagnostics.title: A file-backed Chronicle constraint can only declare uniqueness; use portable unique syntax instead.

diagnostics.name: LegacyInlineCodeFence
diagnostics.title: An inline code block uses a legacy language line, or a description uses a bare fence.

diagnostics.name: IncompleteReducerTransitions
diagnostics.title: A reducer contains both implemented and unimplemented event transitions.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateReducerEvent
diagnostics.title: A reducer observes the same resolved event more than once.

diagnostics.name: MissingReadsAlias
diagnostics.title: Multiple reads of one view require an alias on every instance.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateReadsAlias
diagnostics.title: Two reads in one command or reaction trigger use the same alias.

diagnostics.name: ReadsAliasConflictsWithProperty
diagnostics.title: A reads alias has the same name as a command property or reaction trigger value.

diagnostics.name: AttachmentPathRefused
diagnostics.title: An implementation file path is absolute, escapes the root, or is not portable.

diagnostics.name: AttachmentLinkRefused
diagnostics.title: An implementation file or one of its parent directories is a symbolic link or reparse point.

diagnostics.name: AttachmentMissing
diagnostics.title: An implementation file does not exist beneath the root.

diagnostics.name: AttachmentTooLarge
diagnostics.title: An implementation file exceeds the per-file or aggregate size limit.

diagnostics.name: AttachmentUnreadable
diagnostics.title: An implementation file cannot safely be read as UTF-8 text.

diagnostics.name: MixedPolicyImplementation
diagnostics.title: A policy combines a require condition with a file or inline code implementation.

diagnostics.name: RepeatedPolicyRequirement
diagnostics.title: A policy declares more than one require line.

diagnostics.name: UnknownReactionReadsKey
diagnostics.title: A reaction reads by a value its trigger does not take.

diagnostics.name: ClockTriggerReadsKey
diagnostics.title: A clock trigger reads by a value, but clock triggers take no values.

diagnostics.name: AmbiguousReactionReadsValue
diagnostics.title: A trigger read uses a primitive type name that could be a trigger value named reads.

diagnostics.name: DeprecatedProjectionTransitionCardinality
diagnostics.title: A flat ESM projection transition uses a deprecated optional or many affected-instance cardinality.

diagnostics.name: InvalidEventGeneration
diagnostics.title: An event generation is zero, out of range, or uses Chronicle's reserved unspecified value.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateEventGeneration
diagnostics.title: An event declares the same generation twice in one slice.

diagnostics.name: MissingEventGeneration
diagnostics.title: An event does not declare every generation from 1 to its current generation in one slice.

diagnostics.name: UnsupportedEventGenerationSemantics
diagnostics.title: The executable model does not yet admit event generations without migration semantics.

diagnostics.name: ClockTriggerValue
diagnostics.title: A clock trigger takes a value, but clock occurrences have no values.

diagnostics.name: ReadsWithChildren
diagnostics.title: A reads declaration has child lines, but reads takes no body.

diagnostics.name: RepeatedProjectionAutoMap
diagnostics.title: More than one automap setting appears in a projection block; only the last setting applies.

diagnostics.name: InvalidAbsentReadModelStep
diagnostics.title: An absent read-model assertion is malformed or has child mappings.

diagnostics.name: InvalidFileImport
diagnostics.title: An import inside a module or feature does not name files as import "<path or glob>".

diagnostics.name: FileImportMatchesNothing
diagnostics.title: A file import pattern with wildcards matches no .play file.

diagnostics.name: ImportedFileNotFound
diagnostics.title: A file import names one file, without wildcards, and that file does not exist.

diagnostics.name: ConflictingImportPlacement
diagnostics.title: Two imports place the same file in scopes where neither lies inside the other.

diagnostics.name: ImportCycle
diagnostics.title: Imports place a file inside itself, so its placement never settles.

diagnostics.name: ModuleInPlacedFile
diagnostics.title: A file imported into a module or feature declares a module other than the one it is placed in.

diagnostics.name: UnexpectedInPlacedFile
diagnostics.title: The top level of a file imported into a module or feature holds something that scope cannot.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationClock
diagnostics.title: A given clock or when clock does not state one ISO 8601 instant, or given clock is repeated.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationTrigger
diagnostics.title: A when trigger line is not when trigger <Trigger>.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationCapture
diagnostics.title: A given capture or when capture line is not <given|when> capture <Capture>.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationQueryAction
diagnostics.title: A when query line is not when query <Query>, or a then result line is not then result [exactly].

diagnostics.name: MismatchedSpecificationQueryResult
diagnostics.title: A query result is asserted without when query, or when query asserts no result, no empty result and no denial.

diagnostics.name: UnknownSpecificationTrigger
diagnostics.title: A when trigger names a trigger nothing declares or registers, or a value its declaration does not carry.

diagnostics.name: UnknownSpecificationCapture
diagnostics.title: A given capture or when capture names a capture the application does not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnknownSpecificationQueryArgument
diagnostics.title: A when query argument is not a by or filter parameter of the query.

diagnostics.name: EventSourceIdInPayload
diagnostics.title: The command identifier is also copied into its same-source event payload.

diagnostics.name: ExplicitProducesTargetsRequired
diagnostics.title: Mixed event sources require explicit destinations on every production.

diagnostics.name: RedundantEventId
diagnostics.title: An event identity pin repeats the current name.

diagnostics.name: InvalidEventId
diagnostics.title: An event identity pin is malformed or duplicated.

diagnostics.name: InlineEventCollision
diagnostics.title: An inline event collides with another declaration or import.

diagnostics.name: InlineEventOutsideCommand
diagnostics.title: An inline event is declared outside a command.

diagnostics.name: InlineEventGeneration

diagnostics.name: ReservedProductionMetadata
diagnostics.title: A production supplies system-assigned metadata or an inline origin.

diagnostics.name: InvalidEventDocumentation
diagnostics.title: Event documentation is not a single nonempty fenced Markdown block.

diagnostics.name: OmittedProductionDestination
diagnostics.title: A plain production omits its destination although the command has an identifier.

diagnostics.name: LegacyOptionalSuffix
diagnostics.title: A type reference uses the legacy optional suffix.

diagnostics.name: InvalidOptionalModifierOrder
diagnostics.title: The optional modifier follows identifier instead of the type.

diagnostics.name: OptionalReadsNotSupported

diagnostics.name: GeneratedPropertyOutsideCommand
diagnostics.title: A generated property is declared outside a command.

diagnostics.name: InvalidGeneratedType
diagnostics.title: A generated property is not a required scalar Uuid-backed concept.

diagnostics.name: InvalidGeneratedModifierOrder
diagnostics.title: Property modifiers are repeated or out of order.

diagnostics.name: GeneratedPropertySuppliedAsInput
diagnostics.title: A generated property is supplied as request or form input.

diagnostics.name: InvalidCommandResponse

diagnostics.name: InvalidResponseSource
diagnostics.title: A response source is unknown or is not a direct command property.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateResponseField
diagnostics.title: A record response repeats a field name.

diagnostics.name: InvalidResponseShape
diagnostics.title: A response has an unsupported shape or mismatched explicit type.

diagnostics.name: InvalidGeneratedFixture
diagnostics.title: A generated fixture is invalid.

diagnostics.name: InvalidReturnExpectation
diagnostics.title: A return expectation is invalid or conflicts with another outcome.

diagnostics.name: InvalidImplementationBlock
diagnostics.title: Implementation wrapper syntax is invalid.

diagnostics.name: InvalidImplementationHint
diagnostics.title: An implementation hint is not one nonblank quoted string.

diagnostics.name: ConflictingImplementationSources
diagnostics.title: Wrapped and direct sources conflict, or multiple payloads were supplied.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSystemDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A system declaration is malformed.

diagnostics.name: InvalidOperationDeclaration
diagnostics.title: An operation declaration is malformed.

diagnostics.name: InvalidProductionReference
diagnostics.title: A production reference is unresolved, ambiguous or qualifies an event.

diagnostics.name: ProductionDeclarationCollision

diagnostics.name: OperationOutsideCommand
diagnostics.title: An operation production appears outside a command.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSystemReference
diagnostics.title: An operation's system reference is missing, repeated or unknown.

diagnostics.name: InvalidOperationMapping
diagnostics.title: An operation input mapping is invalid.

diagnostics.name: InvalidOperationSpecification
diagnostics.title: An operation specification step is invalid.

diagnostics.name: InvalidEventSourceDeclaration
diagnostics.title: An event source or stream declaration is invalid or ambiguous.

diagnostics.name: InvalidCommandStream
diagnostics.title: A command stream reference or mapping is invalid.

diagnostics.name: AmbiguousCommandStream
diagnostics.title: A command header has viable property and route interpretations.

diagnostics.name: UnsupportedStreamIdType
diagnostics.title: A stream id type is neither text/UUID (or their concepts) nor an integer-backed concept.

diagnostics.name: RedundantSourceStreamId
diagnostics.title: A rename pin repeats a source or stream's current name.

diagnostics.name: InvalidNumericDirective
diagnostics.title: A numeric mode directive has an unknown or malformed spelling.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateNumericDirective
diagnostics.title: A document repeats its numeric preamble.

diagnostics.name: LateNumericDirective
diagnostics.title: A numeric preamble follows domain, imports or declarations.

diagnostics.name: InexactNumericLiteral
diagnostics.title: A complete numeric literal is outside the exact Decimal domain.

diagnostics.name: MixedNumericModes
diagnostics.title: Physical documents disagree on their numeric interpretation.

diagnostics.name: IncompatibleNumericSource
diagnostics.title: Syntax options or inserted numeric values disagree with the owning mode.

diagnostics.name: UnknownReadModelProperty
diagnostics.title: A projection maps to a property absent from the declared read-model shape.

diagnostics.name: PiiNotSupportedOnIdentifier
diagnostics.title: A concept marked @pii or @sensitive is used as an event source identifier.

diagnostics.name: EventFromLaterSlice
diagnostics.title: A slice uses an event or reads a read model from a slice drawn after it on the timeline. Reads built from events produced on the reader's side of the lowest common container are excluded.

diagnostics.name: TimelineCycleGroup
diagnostics.title: A timeline group depends on each other's events or non-feedback read models; reordering cannot make every dependency flow left to right.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationExample
diagnostics.title: A typed specification example declaration is malformed.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateSpecificationAssignment
diagnostics.title: A specification fixture assigns the same property more than once.

diagnostics.name: UnresolvedSpecificationExampleType
diagnostics.title: A specification example type or reference is unknown, ambiguous, or unsupported.

diagnostics.name: SpecificationExampleNameCollision
diagnostics.title: A specification example name collides with a type or another example in its scope.

diagnostics.name: SpecificationExampleKindMismatch
diagnostics.title: A specification step uses an example of another kind.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationExampleValue
diagnostics.title: A specification example supplies a value not allowed by its current type.

diagnostics.name: MissingSpecificationProperty
diagnostics.title: An exact-shape specification step omits a required property after example expansion.

diagnostics.name: UnadmittedSpecificationExampleValue
diagnostics.title: A stated example value or destination cannot be admitted by its semantic type, even if unused.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationExampleBody
diagnostics.title: A typed specification example declares route metadata instead of stating it on a step.

diagnostics.name: ConflictingScreenDataBinding
diagnostics.title: Visible screen data bindings share a name but disagree on query, cardinality or parameter.

diagnostics.name: ScreenDataQueryMismatch
diagnostics.title: A screen data binding disagrees with the resolved query return shape.

diagnostics.name: ActionWithoutInputSurface
diagnostics.title: A screen action has no command-bound input surface.

diagnostics.name: CommandWithoutInputSurface
diagnostics.title: A StateChange command has no UI issuer and is not reaction-invoked.

diagnostics.name: ReadModelFieldWithoutOrigin
diagnostics.title: A read model has no builder or a declared field has no projection origin.

diagnostics.name: QueryParameterNotHeldByView
diagnostics.title: A query parameter cannot be held by its view's structurally known identity or fields.

diagnostics.name: UnconsumedEvent
diagnostics.title: A locally declared event has no declared application consumer.

diagnostics.name: UnreachableScreen
diagnostics.title: A screen is unreachable from contributions or attached shell-level behaviors.

diagnostics.name: InvalidRefusalBranch
diagnostics.title: A refusal branch header is malformed or appears outside a command invocation.

diagnostics.name: InvalidRefusalBranchBody
diagnostics.title: A refusal branch does not contain either acknowledge alone or event productions.

diagnostics.name: UnreachableRefusalBranch
diagnostics.title: A refusal branch is shadowed by an earlier branch or cannot target the invoked command's events.

diagnostics.name: InvalidRefusalValue
diagnostics.title: A refusal value has an invalid member, scope or target type.

diagnostics.name: UnknownRefusalConstraint
diagnostics.title: A named refusal constraint is not declared.

diagnostics.name: UnmatchedRedeliveredOccurrence
diagnostics.title: A redelivery action is malformed or does not identify exactly one given event occurrence.

diagnostics.name: UnknownRedeliveryReaction
diagnostics.title: A redelivery reaction is unknown, ambiguous or does not observe the stated event.

diagnostics.name: InvalidNoEventsExpectation
diagnostics.title: A no-event assertion is malformed or conflicts with another outcome or an append action.

diagnostics.name: IndeterminateNegatedClaimTarget
diagnostics.title: A negated claim comparison uses a target that can be absent, null, or is not a string type.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationStream
diagnostics.title: A specification routing directive is malformed, duplicated or misplaced.

diagnostics.name: SpecificationStreamOnCommand
diagnostics.title: A command occurrence cannot declare its own route.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationStreamRoute
diagnostics.title: A specification route or stream id cannot resolve or is incompatible.

diagnostics.name: InvalidSpecificationStreamEventSource
diagnostics.title: A routed occurrence lacks a concrete compatible source identity.

diagnostics.name: SpecificationStreamContradictsCommand
diagnostics.title: An exclusive producer contradicts its expected occurrence route.

diagnostics.name: UndeclaredDependency
diagnostics.title: An opted-in container uses a producer it did not declare.

diagnostics.name: UnusedDependencyDeclaration
diagnostics.title: No counted explicit reference uses a declared dependency.

diagnostics.name: InvalidDependencyTarget
diagnostics.title: A declared dependency target is unresolved, self, an ancestor, or a descendant.

diagnostics.name: RepeatedDependencyDeclaration
diagnostics.title: A dependency is declared more than once on the same container.

diagnostics.name: MutualDependencyDeclarations
diagnostics.title: Two containers declare each other as dependencies.

diagnostics.name: AuthorizationRefusalWithoutIdentity
diagnostics.title: An authorization refusal branch invokes an authorization-gated command without a declared identity.

diagnostics.name: InvalidDocumentation
diagnostics.title: A documentation directive requires one nonempty fenced markdown block.

diagnostics.name: ConflictingDocumentationAcrossFiles
diagnostics.title: Files give conflicting documentation for the same module or feature.

view.description: Source detail views return compact-header-v1, not full syntax: header metadata sizes and AST/source read pointers, then actual-parent child pages. Source pages enforce item and serialized-byte bounds; continue from nextOffset.

beforeWorkspaceJson.description: Complete canonical UTF-8 export-workspace JSON for the baseline, decoded and reassembled from export pages; not a Git ref or path.

afterWorkspaceJson.description: Complete canonical UTF-8 export-workspace JSON for the candidate, with the same application identity; not a Git ref or path.

expectedSourceRevision.description: Echo the ordered-pair sourceRevision on continuation. Both snapshot revisions are pinned, including catalogs and exact source.
